desc:
You find yourself in front of the Piggy Household for some reason. Do you dare enter?

Update: It turns out guys you have to enter to be able to escape the map. So, uh, looks like you'll be entering. If you dare...

You need to find all of the keys and escape to get the badge! Good luck!

Tags: Piggy, Roblox, House, Horror, some other stuff I guess
